senses.gloss: to improve something by adding value, variety, or quality

translations.th_TH: ทำให้รวย/ทำให้สมบูรณ์

definition_translations.zh_TW: 透過增加價值、多樣性或品質來改善某事物
definition_translations.ja_JP: 価値、多様性、または質を加えて改善する
definition_translations.ko_KR: 가치, 다양성 또는 품질을 더해 개선하다
definition_translations.vi_VN: cải thiện điều gì bằng cách thêm giá trị, sự đa dạng hoặc chất lượng
definition_translations.th_TH: ปรับปรุงบางสิ่งโดยเพิ่มคุณค่า ความหลากหลาย หรือคุณภาพ

senses.example: The investment enriched several early shareholders.
